repository.repositorySHA1Basis: Wikimedia Commons page structured metadata; SHA-1 is NOT an independently verified original-file SHA-256.
repository.rightsDetails: Author died 1940; edition printed 1920; Commons describes its reproduction as a mechanical scan of a public-domain original and identifies the work public-domain in countries with term <=life+80, and in US pre-1931.

visualInspection.method: Full-resolution (1265 x 964) image displayed by web media viewer on 2026-10-19; no original bytes downloaded into working container.
visualInspection.depicts: Historically attested illustration of Roman Catholic priest bent toward altar with hands together raised near his mouth, chalice present on altar, acolyte kneeling nearby and congregation behind rail.
excludedMisuses: Do not represent this as the chalice Communion moment.
Do not infer the Host is physically visible, divided, or consumed in this image.
Do not infer precise Ritus Servandus X.4 elbow placement from indistinct drawing.
Do not substitute this 1920 source drawing for the user-approved bank style.
visualInspection.rubricalWitness: Ritus servandus X.4: after consuming both halves, priest rises, joins thumbs and index fingers, puts hands joined before face, pauses in meditation. Drawing's hands-joined-before-face resembles this, but does not prove chronology from visual alone.

harmonization.notes: Source has high-detail pen hatching and full church setting; any icon would require licensed PD-source-derived simplified accurate drawing matching approved priest icons, with proof at 32 and 48 px. Head-and-hands before face appear more consistent with the pause after consuming than with Host visibly in mouth: avoid deceptive icon substitution.

verdict.next: Treat as post-Host Communion contextual illustration; do not adapt to a CONSUMES HOST icon without a genuinely visible original of the two Host halves at the mouth and elbows on altar. Need separate exact chalice source and actual file hash.
